note: The owner's NFP formula (6 Oct): (N + 1 - 2F)/(3 sqrt((N + 1)/(3 (N - 1))) (N - 1)), a place as a z-score over its field divided by 3, so a place counts for more in a big field. On 61,423 GB/IE races from 2022 it predicted the winner a little better than the engine's NFP over every window (+0.5 to +0.9 millinats a race; research/queries/done/nfp_formula_check.py) and, like it, adds nothing beside the BSP. The block (nz_, model/blocks/nfp_z.py) carries it over career, last run, the last 3/5/10, the last 5 weighted, exponential in runs (3, 6) and in days (a year). main_nz is the served main (the base, cached) plus the block at the served recipe, scored on the price forecast, the rule and the owner's staking (GBP250 to win at expected CLV >= 0/3/5%).
